main_body: Sci-fi building: a pale blue-grey sloped panel roof with two skylight vents, an orange eave band, and a grey front wall with two cyan windows, two dark windows and a central double door
top_band: Light blue-grey roof panels with lighter seams, rows ~1-16, ending in a pale front-edge line at rows 16-17
evidence: Down the middle column, the roof reads as a large foreshortened surface (rows 1-16) with vents and panel seams. It ends in a pale edge line at rows 16-17, then an orange eave band (rows 19-20) and a darker strip below it. The front wall (rows 21-43) has dark-framed windows and a door set into a frame. Both the top and the front face are clearly drawn, so this is a 3/4 view.

style.evidence: The roof and wall have about 4-5 value steps, and the outlines are dark navy that leans blue next to the blue-grey material, not pure black. Texture is limited to seams, a few speckle dots on the wall and the vent details. The roof panels (about 8x8 px) and the wall panels are large flat single-colour fills. The reference roof has per-tile scallops and its walls have speckle and stone shading, so most candidate tiles carry fewer colours. Next to the reference it looks flatter and thinner, so it fails.
